summary: Spec review PASS: all 8 acceptance criteria plus the concurrency and server-authoritative edge cases are covered by tests that assert behavior independently of implementation (dependencies mocked at module boundaries), with strong, contract-consistent assertions (exact status codes, body shapes, and mock-call arguments). Five advisory findings recorded (unauthenticated 401 paths untested, modal default router.refresh path untested, checkbox a11y label not asserted, redundant route-level version test, no direct getAcceptanceStatus unit test); none block any acceptance criterion. The single tester-reported failing test (recordAcceptance 23505 race) correctly encodes contract Interface 4 — its failure is an implementation defect, not a spec-encoding defect.

verification.notes: Per role constraints, tests were not run and no implementation files were opened. Review was performed by reading ticket.md, contract.md, and the nine test files only. spec-review.json is valid JSON with the required 'verdict' and 'findings' fields.

follow_ups: SR-01: Add unauthenticated (getCurrentTeacherId -> null) cases asserting 401 {error:'unauthenticated'} for terms-acceptance GET/POST and upload POST, and that the downstream helpers are not called.
SR-02: Add a TermsAcceptanceModal case with onAccepted omitted asserting router.refresh() is called once on a successful submit.
SR-03: Assert the modal checkbox has an accessible name (associated <label>/aria-label) to enforce the contract's accessibility requirement.
SR-05: Consider a direct unit test for getAcceptanceStatus (no row / matching / older version) to cover its branching in isolation.
